findings.message: Scope manifest could not be read (permission denied), so out-of-scope edits and in-scope-but-untouched files cannot be fully enumerated against the declared plan.

Adding exit_code at the top-level result (alongside data.exit_code) is an implementation contract change that may extend beyond the original scope; prior SPEC-7 explicitly asserted exit_code must NOT appear at top level, and the plan may not have included promoting it there.

SPEC-7 was semantically inverted: the original assertion tested that exit_code is absent at top level (data-encapsulation); the replacement asserts it is present at top level — a contract reversal that may be an unplanned scope expansion rather than a refinement.

SPEC-1 through SPEC-8 were completely re-authored to assert different fields (test_output, run_mode, exit_code at top level) rather than the original contract fields (result_contract, disposition, data encapsulation); if the plan described specific SPEC assertions, the replacement assertions may drift from that declared scope.
